notes.title: Update Patch v1.53 and Future
notes.content:
[h1]Patch Notes[/h1]
I've done a small patch to add a functionality suggested by ziero.

When you are now controlling the power of your shot, you can press SHIFT to slow down that boost bar growth to help you in those delicate shots (That AG_1 hole 8 needs to be hit in the right spot :D )

Also, I've renamed the maps instead of AG_X, it's now Course X.

[h1]Future[/h1]
I'll continue to fix bugs that are reported by the community and add suggestions to the game as I see fit.
But as requested by some, I'll be doing something that I believe was never done before. I'll release the [b]full source code of the entire game[/b]! 

Yes, I'll be putting it as a DLC, the full source code and assets for the game, including scripts, networking system and pretty much.. EVERYTHING*.

If you are interested in game dev, or just want to know how the game is made, I welcome you to try the source code once it's released.

I'll be announcing the release soon, just have to wait for Steam to "greenlight" the idea. 


*Not everything, as I have to delete some Steam-bound parts or else there would be some hacking into the original, but the core gameplay and all that stays don't worry.

notes.title: v1.52 Update
notes.content:
These were suggestions and feedback by Ziero1986.

- Training was improved and you can now choose any map from your library to train on.

- Power meter now has marks to help shooting power.

- Boosts were nerfed again.

- Zoom keys for those who don't have mouse wheel are now added and can be changed in the game's initial dialog.

- Aim line texture is now yellow to see better.

- Partial controller support added. You can aim/shoot/respawn/zoom in out camera with a controller.

Any problem with the game please report it.

notes.title: Steam P2P Update
notes.content:
Hi everyone!

Steam P2P implementation is going very good. 
- The lobby creation and join is done, and as you can see in the image below, there's a small patch of terrain where the players that are inside the lobby can show off their balls customization and chat with other players.

- The owner can start the game whenever he/she desires. When that happens, the map is loaded into the server and sent to every player that reads and spawns the map's objects.

- After the map is loaded, players are teleported to the first hole and the game begins! 

Until now, this is what is made, but what's left?

- After a player finishes every hole in the map, it will be teleported to the begining terrain with a finishing order (Winners in the front, losers in the back). 

- After owner of the lobby finishes, he/she can choose the next map and the whole process begins again.


So, the system is going pretty good. The next step is to create the P2P synchronization system, so every position, rotation and velocity are synced between players.

This system will be a better option for those under a strict NAT router, that aren't allowed to join or be joined in normal rooms.


[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/27219480/52cdc23ec2ba1cf5b400c3ce8625abc128a0ca4a.png[/img]

notes.title: New Map Editor
notes.content:
Hi everyone!

There will be a new Update for AffordaGolf Online! In this update the main features will be the new Steam P2P system, with changes like in-game chat and Ball ShowOff, and a NEW IMPROVED MAP EDITOR.

[h1] Map Editor [/h1]

The new map editor will be totally redesigned, with a better UI (with pictures of the modules) and new settings for each map, to make it as customizable as possible. This also means there will be a new map data format, which will be lighter in size. (The average to beat is the 12KB of the current generation maps). Dont worry, the new map editor will be backwards compatible with older maps.


[h1] Steam P2P [/h1]

The Steam P2P system is also being worked on. It will take some time due to the need to re-write pretty much how the online game plays out, but since I'll be re-writing stuff, might aswell make it better right? So, I'll add a in-game chat and a Lobby Ball Showoff, where you can show how your ball looks like to other players before the game begins, and when the map is finished there will be a Ball Showoff aswell displaying the positions of the players (1st, 2nd, 3rd etc). 


When I have more details (and screenshots) I'll post here, don't worry.
Thank you!

notes.title: Summer Update Multiplayer Fixes
notes.content:
Another note of the upcoming update.

I've tried to implement the new networking model to make simulated physics more accurate but with no success. It didn't work out very well, so instead the server update frequency was increased to 30hz.

To improve physics, the bounciness of the ball was increased 25% and should collide and behave more realistic.

So for the new update only thing left is Steam P2P which I still haven't touched and the new map using new modules which is being taken care of.

Thanks again for the amazing support and hope you enjoy the update :)

Coming June 20th.

notes.title: Summer Update Modules
notes.content:
Hi guys, Summer Update is near being released.

So far I've been working on the new modules and workshop features and those are done.

The new modules as you can see in the image below are mainly loops:
- 180º degree loop
- 270º degree loop
- 360º degree loop
- Long Ramp
- Water planes.

Also, now when you publish your map to Steam Workshop, a screenshot will be taken and added as a preview for your workshop item, so that players can see upfront how your map looks like. 

And for now this is what I've to show. I'm still finishing up college works but I think everything is on schedule for what I've promised.

[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/27219480/47cda00f2f8af153eac1f76d3af00925c116cf77.png[/img]
About the other features, the player controller is being completely revamped as till now the thing that was being synchronized was position and velocities, and sometimes physics (collisions) weren't accurate between server and clients, so now what I'm planning to do is to revamp the network model and send direct player input to every client so that everyone has a clear representation of the server's game state. For other words, instead of syncing every player's position, only the first input will be sent to all clients and each client then calculates the position, collisions and all that. This will not only reduce network traffic, but also (in theory) make for a more smoother and realistic experience.

Regarding server and hosting, I haven't touched Steam P2P yet, but I'm reading the documentation and trying to come up with a Network model that fits the game. This however will be secondary.

Thanks a lot for the support :)

notes.title: Summer Big Update!
notes.content:
Hi guys, just saying that the game isn't dead. 
Since the latest update I've been super busy with my college degree, lots of work (not gaming related) and I couldn't work much on the game.

But now, I'm here to show you what is coming for AffordaGolf in the Summer*.

[h1]Steam Matchmaking improvements	[/h1]
I've receive some inputs about Steam Matchmaking not working with some users and I'll fix this.

[h1] Steam P2P alternative   [/h1]
Some users are behind severe ISP blocking of ports, and can't host a server to play with friends. With Steam P2P this should be resolved and anyone can play with anyone, no matter the ISP blocks. However this will be experimental and may not work at all as I've never used Steam P2P service.

[h1]    New map modules   [/h1]
Some new modules to create new maps

[h1]   NEW MAPS!!!    [/h1]
Using the new and old modules.


[h1]   Steam Workshop improvement    [/h1]
When exporting to workshop the map will export with screenshots from different angles. (Will see if this is possible, I believe it is)

[h1]    Physics Improvements   [/h1]
Some physics sometimes fail and are not realistic, this will be fixed in this update.


Hope you enjoy and thanks for all your feedback so far!



*It will come before the 21th of June.

notes.title: v1.23 Release!!
notes.content:
Finally it's here!!

What's new?
[list]
    [*]3 New Sticks
    [*]Steam Matchmaking
    [*]Map editor revamp
    [*]Steam Workshop
    [*]Map ratings
[/list]

Steam matchmaking chat has some bugs of repetition, but it's overall working.

The sticks are available by Plinko.
There's 3 sticks: 
[olist]
    [*]Default (green) -> Bad accuracy and normal power
    [*]White -> Good accuracy and normal power
    [*]Black -> Bad accuracy and 20% more power
[/olist]
And then there's the Golden Stick that has 100% accuracy and 200% power, so if you get it, be careful with your shots!

Hope you enjoy, Thanks for playing!

notes.title: v1.23 Status
notes.content:
Happy new year everybody!

I've been working on v1.23 since yesterday and I've got some status updates for you:

[list]
    [*]Maps Ratings* (done)
    [*]Steam Matchmaking (80% done)
    [*]Steam Workshop (80% done)
    [*]Reported bugs fixed (done)
    [*]Different clubs/sticks (with different abilities)
    [*]Plinko revamp as suggested
    [*]Map editor revamp
[/list]

*Map ratings are working but should be entirely replaced by the steam workshop system.

[h1] How steam matchmaking will work:	[/h1]
There will still be a Room Browser working as usual, but now there will be a new Button on the Main Menu which will automatically find any open lobbies on AffordaGolf. If it doesn't find any, it will create one.
Lobbies are pre-rooms, that have a chat and where the creator can choose the map in which that lobby will play. Players in a lobby can say they are ready and once everyone is, the host can start the game. 

Host's ports will be automatically open by the OpenPortTool before starting the match.

This system may help those with connection issues.

[h1] How steam workshop will work:	[/h1]

First you create a map in the new map editor like usual. Then when uploading, instead of uploading to our servers, the map will be uploaded to Steam workshop where everyone can subscribe, rate, comment and so on.

To get a map from steam workshop, it's fairly simple. A player just needs to go to the workshop, find a map, hit subscribe and the map will be downloaded locally for the player.

[h1] How different clubs/sticks will work:	[/h1]
Each player will start with the default stick, which stats are reasonable but could be better. By playing plinko and unlocking new sticks, your stick collection increases and you will end up with a stick for each situation. 
In-game before any shot, you can choose what stick you want for that specific hole/course and change it in the next play turn if you want.

For now I haven't started on these multi-stick system but there are already two stats that each will have: ACCURACY and POWER. And as suggested there will be a [b]GOLDEN STICK[/b] which will be the most rare and best stick there is with perfect ACCURACY and a decent amount of power.


Hope you enjoyed the game in 2016, because it will only get better in 2017!
Thanks for playing, reporting bugs and every feedback you gave me to improve!

notes.title: AffordaGolf v1.22 Patch Released!
notes.content:
[h1]AffordaGolf v1.22 Patch![/h1]

The V1.22 patch is available for everyone.
Here’s what changed:

[list]
    [*]Spawnpoint no more on top of wood.
    [*]Added Map limits to every map. (even user created ones)
    [*]Network tick-rate raised to 20hz. 
    [*]Gameplay UI Sync bug fixed 
    [*]Open port tool fixed.
    [*]Plinko Added.
    [*]Level system 
    [*]Hats Added
    [*]17 new field modules for map creation  
    [*]2 new obstacles for map creation
    [*]Scoreboard Added (tab)   
    [*]3 new maps  
    [*]Mouse lock added  
    [*]Player anti-stuck system added
    [*]Ball customization “stop movement” option added.

[/list]

A little note on Hats and level system:

[h1]How Leveling works in AffordaGolf:[/h1]
Each hole you play counts towards your level. You win 100 points for each hole in one. You lose from those 100 points, 10 points per hit. So if you complete a hole in 3 hits, you win 70 points.

Here's the amount of XP you need to level up:
Level 2 - 803 xp
Level 3 - 1691 xp
Level 4 - 2671 xp
Level 5 - 3753 xp
Level 6 - 4948 xp
Level 7 - 6268 xp
Level 8 - 7725 xp
Level 9 - 9334 xp
Level 10 - 11111 xp
Level 11 - 13072 xp
Level 12 - 15237 xp
Level 13 - 17628 xp
Level 14 - 20268 xp
Level 15 - 23182 xp
Level 16 - 26400 xp
Level 17 - 29953 xp
Level 18 - 33875 xp
Level 19 - 38205 xp
Level 20 - 42985 xp

When you level up, you will have the chance to win a "Plinko" Play. This game is a sort of RNG game that will give prizes to the players. At this moment prizes are hats and other Plinko Plays, but in the future there will be more prizes.


[h1]Hats[/h1]
Most of the hats were made by me, so most of them are a little ugly. This is just a "proof of concept" to show how the system works, and better hats will come in future updates, hope you understand.

[h1]Field Modules[/h1]
Some field moduels may not work with every map type, this will be fixed soon.

[h1]Obstacles[/h1]
Added a bouncy obstacle that will make every ball that touches it, go away, and I mean, away, so be careful.


[h1]Any bugs or questions please contact me.[/h1]

Thank you and I hope you enjoy :)

notes.title: v1.21 Hotfix
notes.content:
This hotfix is meant to fix a room browser bug that would delete rooms after a while. This should never happen again.

I'm sorry for the inconvenience. 

There are some players that aren't being able to join or being joined by others. Please try the following:

1- Make sure you execute the OpenPortTool outside the game. It will propose you to launch the game after but don't launch. Launch always from steam. (When possible)

2- Make sure your firewall isn't blocking the game.

3- If this isn't working it may be because the room browser uses external (or public) IP addresses and you are trying to connect to a local (LAN) room. If this is the case, please try using the local IP address that should be something like 192.168.x.x.

Hope it helps.

Thank you for playing.
